not_file_shaped.reason: Fuzzing is a property of a test run, not of a byte string: the oracle is no panic, no OOM, and round-trip stability over arbitrary input. All six targets and their committed seed corpora are covered by fuzz/fuzz_targets/*, the stable-toolchain mirror in tests/fuzzmirror.rs, and tests/mutation.rs; no single fixture can assert it. The entitlement-chain target landed in 0.13.0 (#107).

An independent second implementation is source code, not a file: the check is that a reader written from spec/SPEC.md alone round-trips every vector. `go/` is that implementation (0.13.0, #53) and runs this same corpus; the row is kept here because a fixture cannot be the check.

vectors.name: golden-minimal
vectors.proves: the minimal bundle of spec §11 is byte-for-byte reproducible through the public writer and parses

vectors.name: golden-demo
vectors.proves: a multi-section bundle with a chunk index and an external section parses and verifies

vectors.name: section-count-over-cap
vectors.proves: section_table_count above MAX_SECTIONS is refused before the table can size an allocation

vectors.name: manifest-huge-length
vectors.proves: a CBOR array claiming u64::MAX elements is refused as CborTruncated without allocating for the claim

vectors.name: payload-inside-header
vectors.proves: an inline payload offset below HEADER_LEN is refused (R12), not read

vectors.name: overlapping-payloads
vectors.proves: two non-empty inline payload ranges that share bytes are refused (T4)

vectors.name: misaligned-payload-offset
vectors.proves: an inline payload offset that is not page-aligned is refused (R12)

vectors.name: payload-beyond-footer
vectors.proves: an inline payload that runs past footer_off is refused (T3)

vectors.name: trailing-byte-after-footer
vectors.proves: a byte appended after the footer is refused; no structure may follow it

vectors.name: truncated-footer
vectors.proves: a footer shorter than MIN_FOOTER_LEN is refused rather than padded. F1 always implies F5 (an unsigned footer must be exactly 56 bytes), so no reader order can make F1 the sole violation; this vector asserts rejection, not a reason

vectors.name: wrong-total-len
vectors.proves: footer total_len must equal the real file length (F7)

vectors.name: signature-slot-length-mismatch
vectors.proves: a suite-1 footer declaring 1-byte signature slots is refused (F10, §8.1, §20.3): the slot lengths are the suite's, so the file cannot be authenticated as itself

vectors.name: truncated-body
vectors.proves: a file shorter than its own table and footer is refused before any of it is read

vectors.name: manifest-cbor-too-deep
vectors.proves: a manifest nested past cbor::MAX_DEPTH is refused as CborTooDeep

vectors.name: compressed-ratio-cap
vectors.proves: a declared plaintext above MAX_DECOMPRESSION_RATIO times len_stored is refused before zstd runs (D2)

vectors.name: compressed-output-cap
vectors.proves: a declared plaintext above MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SECTION is refused before zstd runs; a small stored section also exceeds the ratio, so the fixture asserts refusal rather than one name

vectors.name: duplicate-name-id
vectors.proves: two records sharing a name_id are refused (T2), because name_id is identity

vectors.name: duplicate-manifest-key
vectors.proves: a manifest map with an adjacent duplicate key is refused, never last-wins resolved

vectors.name: manifest-name-traversal
vectors.proves: a name table entry containing a path separator is refused, so traversal is unrepresentable

vectors.name: manifest-name-bidi-control
vectors.proves: a name table entry containing U+202E is refused after UTF-8 decoding, not byte-masked

vectors.name: manifest-payload-flip
vectors.proves: the manifest's record root is verified before CBOR decoding: a flipped map header fails as SectionRootMismatch, not as a manifest error. The signature half of the bullet is caller-gated (§10 step 9) and cannot be exercised without a trusted key the bundle deliberately does not carry

vectors.name: chunk-index-entry-flip
vectors.proves: a tampered index still parses (C rules are on-use) but Bundle::chunk_index reduces it to the root first and refuses it (C4); no entry or chunk is exposed (C7)

vectors.name: bad-magic
vectors.proves: the file signature is checked byte-for-byte

vectors.name: bad-footer-magic
vectors.proves: the footer's repeated magic is checked, not used to locate the footer

vectors.name: non-zero-padding
vectors.proves: bytes belonging to no structure must be zero, so one signature cannot cover two files (T8)

vectors.name: unknown-section-flag-bits
vectors.proves: an unassigned section flag bit is refused rather than ignored

vectors.name: reserved-non-zero
vectors.proves: header reserved bytes are required to be zero

vectors.name: unknown-section-kind
vectors.proves: kind 0 is never valid, even on an ordinary section: it is a rejection (R3), not an unknown optional kind to skip

vectors.name: unknown-enc-discriminant
vectors.proves: an unassigned enc/comp value is refused even on a skippable section

vectors.name: chunk-index-trailing-bytes
vectors.proves: the index length is derived from len_plain/chunk_size, and bytes it no longer claims must be zero

vectors.name: chunk-index-overlaps-table
vectors.proves: a derived chunk-index range is included in overlap detection (T7)

vectors.matrix_row: 0.4+, `feat_incompat` feature in use → 0.3: Rejected, naming the feature (H14)
vectors.name: future-incompat-feature
vectors.proves: an invented feat_incompat bit is refused by name before any structural rule

vectors.matrix_row: 0.3, plus a `ro_compat` bit from a later version → 0.3: Accepted, read-only (§4.4)
vectors.name: future-ro-compat-bit
vectors.proves: an invented feat_ro_compat bit parses, and Header::may_rewrite() is false

vectors.matrix_row: 0.4+, `OPTIONAL` unknown kind → 0.3: Accepted; the section is carried, never interpreted
vectors.name: future-unknown-optional-section
vectors.proves: an OPTIONAL section of an undefined kind parses and is carried, Bundle::section_bytes and Bundle::chunk_index refuse it, and verify_inline_sections still verifies and counts it
